title: Wine & Lunch Tour in Panesdes
text: David did a fabulous job showing us the sites and history of the area! Thoroughly enjoyed the tour! His taste in music was awesome too ☺️
author: Quest17931

title: Farm/winery tour
text:
This was our favorite part of the trip! Our tour guide Enrique took care of everything. 
Delicious food with picturesque scenery and amazing winery tour. Everything was perfect! Will definitely use this company again for other trips.
author: victoriasZ9000FC

title: Great day trip
text: My husband, me and our 21 yo daughter went on this trip. We had a great time with henrick as our tour guide. We started with breakfast and a tour of the market. Then made a quick stop in tibidabo, then off to a family run olive/ oil making spot, lunch, then finished with a wine tour. It was a packed day that we all thoroughly enjoyed. We would highly recommend. We ate, drank, laughed and learned a lot.
author: Kris_M

title: Highly recommended.
text: What a wonderful way to experience a traditional meal. Strangers become friends, the paella was delicious, and Simon was fabulous. I learned so much about what goes into a traditional paella. I highly recommend this.
author: Kerstin_M

title: Great Food & Wine Experience
text: Rod was an excellent guide.  His expansive knowledge across  multiple topics was very informative.  The tour was comprised of diverse stops which provided a well rounded experience. Rod was very accommodating - adapting to our requests and proactive in identifying stops that would interest us.  All of this, made for an excellent day.  Highly recommend Rod and this tour.
author: KSmith2703

title: Vacation
text:
Everything was wonderful, Rodrigo was a excellent guide and all 3 wineries were different in there own way, super friendly. Would definitely recommend to everyone.
Lunch was also very good!
author: Z4449PKmaryl

title: Penedas wine tour
text: Was a wonderful tour highly recommend.  Each winery was a different experience.  Felt incredibly welcome.  Our guide Rodrigo, was fantastic.
author: Daniel G

title: Hire Berta for this Tour
text: OK, if you care anything about Barcelona's food and wine scene and you know you do. Hire Berta to take you on this tour. She was amazing!  Our only complaint was we ate too much!
author: a1963corvette

title: Great Day out in Catalunya!
text: Such a fun tour with excellent guides. You should definitely come hungry because they are sure to provide lots of food options and great views of Catalunya.
author: Evangeline_M

title: A Day Trip Worth Taking
text: The tour was outstanding: the sights, the food, the wine and learning about the history and culture of Catalunya from a wonderful guide, Jordy. Getting out of the city and eating at authentic restaurants was a great opportunity. Jordy gave us wonderful perspective on the food, the culture, the wine, the history, sports, etc. It was definitely the best tour I have taken.
author: Kelly_M
